articles.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
articles.description: Ukraine accused Russia of targeting the crowded vehicles in the front line city of Kramatorsk to kill as many civilians as possible.

articles.title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
articles.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.

articles.title: 'Every day there is killing': Palestinians in Gaza face Israeli strikes despite ceasefire as peace deal stalls
articles.description: Many Palestinians are still living in cramped tent cities, with the US plan to end the war largely stalled.

articles.title: South Korea recalls Ukraine envoy over prisoner-of-war row
articles.description: It is the latest in a diplomatic spat after Kyiv disclosed that two North Korean prisoners were transferred to Seoul.

articles.title: Bear kills man in home attack near Mongolian capital
articles.description: Police say the bear entered a traditional nomadic dwelling near Ulaanbaatar, killing a man and seriously injured a woman.

articles.title: Margaret Hamilton, whose software helped land Apollo 11 on the Moon, dies at 90
articles.description: Pioneering computer scientist led the development of the software for Nasa's Apollo mission and was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom.

articles.title: One dead in Poland's second school attack in two days
articles.description: A school employee was killed and two others were injured after a knife attack in Poland - the second such incident in the country in two days

articles.title: Seven injured in attack at Polish school, say police
articles.description: A man has been arrested after seven people were injured in an attack at a school in Poland.

articles.title: Man to face trial for attempted murder of British girl in Alps knife attack
articles.description: A man who allegedly stabbed a British toddler at a playground in the French Alps will go on trial charged with attempted murder, prosecutors have said.
